messages:
maria: Heads up — we need to lock down the plan for shipping private/VPC metrics export. CTO asked for a clear path: agent handshake, firewall requirements, KMS signing, and how the Console dashboards will consume the data. Who wants to take ownership of the export spec?
kevin: I can drive the platform side. Two quick Qs: do we expect customers to push to our endpoint (agent -> redwood) or should our agent pull from the customer side? Pull is harder with firewalls.
jin: runtime view — prefer push from agent to our ingress (TLS + mTLS) so we can centralize parsing and guarantee schema. Pull would require opening inbound ports on customer infra or a relay, which most customers hate.
nashley-security: :lock: Push + mTLS is fine, but we need KMS integration for key material. Customers want their key/cert stored in their KMS and for the agent to sign packets with keys that never leave the HSM. How do we verify without keeping customer keys?
samir: Also, firewall constraints: many on-prem setups only allow HTTPS outbound via proxy. We should make the export work over 443 and support HTTP proxies + env var config. Also need fallback for stricter egress (egress via customer-approved proxy).
maria: Sounds like direction: agent pushes to our telemetry ingest endpoint over 443, mTLS using cert signed by customer's KMS/HSM, or short-lived client certs provisioned via a bootstrap handshake. Need audit hooks so customer audit logs show export activity.
kevin: Implementation note: we can support two bootstrap modes: 1) long-lived certs uploaded by tenant admin (good for air-gapped installs) 2) short-lived client certs from Redwood’s CA after verifying a signed CSR that was generated with keys in customer KMS. For 2) we never see the private key. That covers security ask.
nashley-security: Yes, mode 2 is preferred for hosted Private. For air-gapped/air-gapped-onprem we'd allow mode 1 but require offline key import and admin attestation. Also we need to emit audit events: `metrics.export.started`, `metrics.export.handshake`, `metrics.export.failed` that are writeable to the customer's audit log sink (syslog/S3).
jin: For runtime metrics, we need the agent to include the following in each payload: `instance_id`, `model`, `seq_len_histogram` (last 1h), `gpu_util_avg`, `kv_cache_hit_ratio`. These will feed new dashboards in Console. Keep payload compact (gzipped protobuf/json).
samir: Firewall rule suggestion (customer-facing doc): allow outbound TCP 443 to telemetry.redwood-internal.net (IP ranges provided per region) and allow proxy CONNECT. Example iptables snippet for customers who lock down via iptables:```
# allow outbound HTTPS to telemetry
iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 443 -d 203.0.113.0/24 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 443 -j DROP
```
kevin: Good. For network policy on our side, agent must present `X-Export-Org` header and mTLS cert CN must match org id, we will reject if CN mismatch. Also we should rate-limit by org and route through dedicated ingestion pool for Private deployments to avoid noisy tenants affecting hosted ops.
maria: UX/console needs: 1) per-tenant export status (connected/last-heartbeat), 2) handshake logs +- last 72h, 3) toggle for export + quotas (max events/sec). Devex: can we show a one-click diagnostic (download last handshake log, curl command) for customers?
devex-bot: yes — propose a "Diagnostics" card in the Private Console. It will surface: bootstrap CSR snippet, sample curl push, recommended firewall rules, and a one-click test that returns `200 OK` if agent can reach ingest. Also add a rollout UX: enable in tenant -> canary -> 25% -> 100%.
kevin: Rollout plan: feature flag gated. Phase 1 (internal test tenants), Phase 2 (pilot customers, manual enable), Phase 3 (auto enable for new Private installs). Canary routing: route 1% of exports to new ingestion pipeline and compare metrics. We need a regression alarm for ingestion latency and parsing errors.
jin: On schema versioning: include `schema_v` in payload. If we change schema, agent should send both vN and compressed `legacy` for 48h to allow smooth rollouts.
nashley-security: Audit/logging: we must provide an option for customers to send the same audit events to their own SIEM. So export the audit events as CloudTrail-like JSON to S3 or syslog. Also record the KMS key id used in the handshake (masked).
samir: Ops: what ports do we require internally for cross-region forwarding? Also need list of IP ranges per region for the doc. Kevin — can you own regional IP list?
kevin: I'll own IP ranges and ingress cert validation. I'll draft a spec with sequence diagrams and the TLS bootstrap flow. Target: PR with the spec by EOD Thursday.
maria: Great. Action items: @kevin spec + IP ranges, @jin payload schema and sample messages, @ashley-security audit event contract & KMS flow, @samir firewall snippets and proxy guidance, @devex-bot diagnostics card mock and rollout copy. I'll coordinate a 30m sync on Friday to approve.
kevin: noted. I'll add the spec link here once it's up. :ship:
devex-bot: Reminder: add the new dashboard tiles to the Console backlog — tag `console-telemetry` and `onprem-exports`.
maria: Thanks everyone — filing follow-ups in the RFC repo.
